notes.title: Update - 2023-03-21
notes.content:
Hey there, everyone!

We've got a small update for you today!

Changes:
[list]
[*] Fixes various text issues, especially with skills.
[*] Fixes an error where suspending in a certain location under certain conditions causes an unintended randomization when resuming.[/list]Thank you for all of the feedback!

notes.title: Update - 2023-03-03
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today, we have a new minor update to address stability issues.

Here's what we've addressed since launch:
[list]
[*] Fix for no audio for some players. Game should properly use xaudio2_9redist.dll on systems on older Windows 10/11 releases.
[*] Fix for the game selecting an unexpected GPU by default for some players.
[list]
[*] On Windows 10 1803 and later, the game should select the GPU in this order:
[olist]
[*] external GPUs
[*] discrete GPUs
[*] internal GPUs[/olist][*] For older versions, the game should select the GPU by the one with the highest amount of dedicated RAM.
[*] In any other case, it will fall back to the original method, based on default initialization.[/list][*] Fixes for crashes related to Alt+Tab and other scenarios in or related to Full Screen mode.
[/list]
Please report any issues in our Troubleshooting forum.

Thank you for all of the feedback and have a nice weekend!

notes.title: Labyrinth of Galleria: The Moon Society is Now Available!
notes.content:
Welcome fans both returning and new, and test your dungeon-diving mettle in [i]Labyrinth of Galleria: The Moon Society[/i], available now! The spiritual successor to [i]Labyrinth of Refrain: Coven of Dusk[/i] brings a cast of new characters, a new labyrinth, and new mysteries to explore!

Gather up your puppet brigade and explore the labyrinth, growing your forces up to 40 soldiers strong! Over 50 hours of DRPG gameplay awaits you!

[b]Labyrinth of Galleria The Moon Society:[/b] Enjoy the base game and explore its wonders and mysteries for yourself.

[b]Labyrinth of Galleria: The Moon Society - Tome of Wonders Art Book[/b]
Add on an art book full of over 200 pages of wonderful creations from the game.	

[b]Labyrinth of Galleria: The Moon Society - Quest Set[/b]	
Perhaps you’d like a few extra quests to complete in-game and reap the rewards for a bit of extra effort?

[b]Labyrinth of Galleria: The Moon Society Deluxe Edition - 10% Discount[/b]
Or, you can get all of the above at a nice discount.

[b]Labyrinth of Refrain & Galleria Deluxe Edition - 15% Discount[/b]
Curious to find out what came before Galleria too? In that case, I recommend this little bundle which includes the first entry in the [i]Labyrinth[/i] series, [i]Labyrinth of Refrain: Coven of Dusk[/i].

Whatever you may decide, I wish you a safe journey!
